theme: Sharing data with a widget: group identifier, shared container, shared defaults

terms.definition: A name that starts with group and is the same in the app and its extensions, so they can share data.
terms.example: Use the same group identifier in the widget.

terms.definition: A folder on disk that the app and its extensions can all read and write.
terms.example: Both targets save the file in the shared container.
terms.code:
import Foundation
let id = "group.com.example.app"
let url = FileManager.default.containerURL(
    forSecurityApplicationGroupIdentifier: id)

terms.definition: Settings saved in a UserDefaults suite that the app and its widget can both read.
terms.example: Save the unread count in shared defaults.
terms.code:
import Foundation
let shared = UserDefaults(suiteName: "group.a")
shared?.set(3, forKey: "unread")
print(shared?.integer(forKey: "unread") ?? 0)

video.title: Group Identifier, Shared Container & Shared Defaults | Day 245
video.description:
Learn to explain how an app and its widget can share the same data: Group Identifier, Shared Container & Shared Defaults, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Group Identifier - A name that starts with group and is the same in the app and its extensions, so they can share data.
Shared Container - A folder on disk that the app and its extensions can all read and write.
Shared Defaults - Settings saved in a UserDefaults suite that the app and its widget can both read.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Group Identifier - A name that starts with group and is the same in the app and its extensions, so they can share data.
한국어: Group Identifier: 앱과 확장이 데이터를 공유할 수 있도록 양쪽에서 똑같이 쓰는, group으로 시작하는 이름

Shared Container - A folder on disk that the app and its extensions can all read and write.
한국어: Shared Container: 앱과 확장이 모두 읽고 쓸 수 있는 디스크 위의 폴더

Shared Defaults - Settings saved in a UserDefaults suite that the app and its widget can both read.
한국어: Shared Defaults: 앱과 위젯이 둘 다 읽을 수 있는 UserDefaults 묶음에 저장된 설정

landscape.hook: Can you explain Group Identifier, Shared Container and Shared Defaults in English?

dialogue.title: Widget and app disagree
dialogue.setting: The widget shows zero unread messages

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, the widget shows zero unread messages, but the app shows three. Why?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: They do not share data yet. Each has its own sandbox, so add both to one app group with the same group identifier.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. It must be the same in the app and in the widget.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And then they can use the same folder?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. That folder is the shared container, and `url` points to it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can the widget write to the shared container too?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, both can read and write there.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What about small values, like the unread count?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use shared defaults. Shared defaults are settings in a suite that both can read.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Exactly. Save the count there, and the widget shows three.
Use the same group identifier in the widget.
